title: Toolshop smoke suite (P1 neutral cases from docs/test-cases.md; TC-CART-1 left out as conformance, defect L1)

scenarios.title: Clicking a product card navigates to its detail page

steps.action: Open the home page as an anonymous visitor
expected: The product grid shows product cards

steps.action: Click a product card in the grid
expected: The product detail page of the clicked product opens, showing that product's name

scenarios.title: Search with a valid 3-40 character query filters the grid

steps.action: Open the home page as an anonymous visitor
Search for the valid query "pliers" (between 3 and 40 characters)
expected: The grid shows only products whose name contains the query

scenarios.title: Category checkbox filters the grid to that category

steps.action: Open the home page as an anonymous visitor
Tick the "Hammer" category checkbox in the filters
expected: The grid shows only products of the Hammer category

scenarios.title: Quantity selector is displayed defaulting to 1

steps.action: Open the detail page of a product that is in stock
expected: A quantity input with plus (+) and minus (-) buttons is displayed

scenarios.title: Guarded routes redirect to login when unauthenticated

expected: The browser is redirected to the login page (#/auth/login)
The browser is redirected to the login page (#/auth/login)
The browser is redirected to the login page (#/auth/login)
The browser is redirected to the login page (#/auth/login)

steps.action: Open the login page and sign in with the configured customer account
expected: The browser is redirected to the customer account page (#/account)

steps.action: Open the login page and sign in with the configured admin account
expected: The browser is redirected to the admin dashboard (#/admin/dashboard)
